title: Ridgeline Warranty Coverage Insulating Glass Option Add-On for Sealed Unit Replacement
content:
**Note.** For a prorated sealed glass replacement under Warranty Coverage, an insulating upgrade is added to each sealed unit when the window contract the registration covers carries the matching change orders on its Window Replacement Contracts record:

- When the window contract carries **triple-pane** change orders covering **every opening** on the contract, each sealed unit adds the triple-pane unit add-on of **95.00**.
- When it instead carries **premium Low-E** change orders covering every opening — triple pane covering fewer than every opening — each unit adds the premium Low-E unit add-on of **40.00**.
- Otherwise there is no insulating upgrade.

"Covering every opening" means the openings affected by the change orders of that kind add up to at least the number of openings on the contract.

## Combinations

| Triple-pane change orders cover every opening | Premium Low-E change orders cover every opening | Insulating upgrade per sealed unit |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | 95.00 |
| no | yes | 40.00 |
| no | no | none |

## Cases (hypothetical 10-opening window contract)

- Triple-pane change orders for 6 openings and for 4 openings: 10 of 10 openings covered, so 95.00 per unit.
- Triple-pane change orders for 7 openings and premium Low-E for all 10: 40.00 per unit.
- Premium Low-E for 9 openings only: no insulating upgrade.
- A registration covering a door contract has no window contract change orders, so no insulating upgrade.
